mapper.select: SELECT l.batch_no, o.order_id, o.reference_id, o.warehouse_id, l.seller_sku, l.supplier_batch_no, o.created_at, NULL::varchar AS location_id, NULL::varchar AS location_code, 'QUARANTINED' AS status, i.defective_quantity - i.isolated_quantity AS quantity FROM wms_inbound_order o JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN wms_purchase_inspection i ON i.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND i.batch_no = l.batch_no WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.reference_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND i.disposed_at IS NOT NULL AND i.defective_quantity > i.isolated_quantity AND o.reference_id = #{purchaseOrderId} ORDER BY o.created_at, l.batch_no
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_purchase_inspection SET isolated_quantity = isolated_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo}
mapper.sql: return_id, receipt_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_line_id, batch_no, warehouse_id, location_id, location_code, seller_sku, requested_quantity, reason, requested_by, requested_at, shipped_quantity, shipped_by, shipped_at
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(requested_quantity), 0) FROM wms_purchase_supplier_return WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND location_id = #{locationId} AND shipped_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_purchase_supplier_return (tenant_id, ) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{document.returnId}, #{document.receiptId}, #{document.purchaseOrderId}, #{document.purchaseOrderLineId}, #{document.batchNo}, #{document.warehouseId}, #{document.locationId}, #{document.locationCode}, #{document.sellerSku}, #{document.requestedQuantity}, #{document.reason}, #{document.requestedBy}, #{document.requestedAt}, NULL, NULL, NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, return_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_purchase_inspection SET returned_quantity = returned_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo}
